def build(+n: Nat, map: Map<&2, U32>) -> Map<&2, U32>:
  match n:
    case 0n: map
    case 1n+rest: build(rest, Map.set(&2, U32, map, String.append("compiler_scope_identifier.", Nat.show(n)), U32.from_nat(n)))

def sum(+map: Map<&2, U32>, n: Nat, acc: U32) -> U32:
  match n:
    case 0n: acc
    case 1n+rest: sum(map, rest, U32.add(acc, Maybe.default(&2, U32, IndexLookup.find(U32, map, "compiler_scope_identifier.32"), 999)))

def probe(n: Nat) -> U32:
  sum(build(64n, MTip{}), n, 0)
